EJE
Written by A. Producer

FADE IN:

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Fluorescent light. LARA walks the length of the corridor, gripping a
paper cup.

LARA
I told you already. I don't remember.

DOCTOR
Take your time.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (CONTINUOUS)

She stops at the window. The reflection is a half-second behind her.

INT. CONSULTING ROOM - DAY

The DOCTOR closes a file. OFFICER TAYO stands by the door, not sitting.

OFFICER TAYO
Ngicela uxolo.

DOCTOR
She needs rest.

EXT. HOSPITAL CAR PARK - NIGHT

Rain on the tarmac. A DETECTIVE waits by an unmarked car, smoking.

DETECTIVE
Two hours. She hasn't said a word.

INT. HOUSE - HALLWAY - NIGHT

Dark. The front door is open. Nobody closed it.

INT. HOUSE - HALLWAY - NIGHT (CONT'D)

LARA steps inside. Behind her, the door swings shut on its own.

INT. HOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT

A kettle boils with nobody near it. Blood pools slowly under the fridge.

LARA
Hello?

INT. HOUSE - BEDROOM - NIGHT

LARA lies on the bed. She rises, six inches, then a foot, then stops.
Her hair hangs downward. The sheet does not move.

INT. HOUSE - BEDROOM - LATER

The room is a different room. Same furniture, wrong dimensions.

INT/EXT. CAR - MOVING - DAY

DETECTIVE drives. LARA in the passenger seat, watching the wing mirror.

DETECTIVE
Tell me about the baby.

EXT. GARDEN - DAY

An empty pram in long grass. The CLEANER LADY stands very still.

CLEANER LADY
Akukho lutho lapha.

EXT. HOUSE EXTERIOR - DUSK

Smoke leaks from under the front door, then draws back in, like breath.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

Twelve empty beds. LARA sits on the thirteenth.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
There was never a baby.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS)

The beds are made. Every one of them.

I/E. AMBULANCE - NIGHT

Doors open on nothing. The DETECTIVE's radio hisses.

INT. CONSULTING ROOM - DAWN

The file on the desk is blank. OFFICER TAYO is already gone.

EXT. HOSPITAL CAR PARK - DAWN

LARA walks out alone. Her reflection in the glass door keeps walking
after she stops.

FADE OUT.

THE END
